title: Lambda phage discovered
summary: Esther Lederberg discovered the bacterial virus lambda phage and the fertility factor F, and devised the first working replica plating.
why: Lambda phage became a workhorse of molecular biology and genetic engineering.

unsung.contribution: Discovered lambda phage and the F factor, and built the first practical replica plating method.
unsung.recognition: Struggled for recognition beside her Nobel-winning husband; textbooks often attribute her accomplishments to him.
